text:
When the Being that one is made nothingness

and rested, which it well deserved,

the day already had night, and company

man had in the absence of the beloved.


Fiat threshold. Human thought sprang up.

and the universal egg lifted, empty,

now without color, desubstantiated and cold,

full of weightless fog, in its hand.


Take the integral zero, the hollow sphere,

which you must look at upright, if you are to see it.

Today that the back of your beast is a back,


and the miracle of non-being is fulfilled,

offer, poet, a border song

to death, to silence and to oblivion.

translation.title: To the Great Zero
translation.editorial_note: The translation preserves the philosophical strangeness of Machado's address to zero and non-being.
